usage: 拉筋 (laai1 gan1) is a noun that refers to the physical activity of stretching muscles to improve flexibility.
You can use 拉筋 after a workout to prevent muscle soreness and injuries.
The word can also describe a session or routine specifically designed for stretching exercises.
拉筋 can be combined with verbs like 做 (zou6) to indicate performing stretches, e.g., 做拉筋 means to do stretching.
It is commonly used in casual and fitness-related conversations when talking about warming up or cooling down.
